# Research Objectives

1. Assess staff retention among nurses in Lagos hospitals.

# Research Questions

What is the level of staff retention among nurses in Lagos hospitals?

# Methods

The sample size was 120 respondents. Data were analysed with RDA procedures. Prior work informed the instrument (Doe, 2021).

# Results

The analysed sample included 140 participants. The response rate was 80% during data collection. The final response rate was 75%.

Table 1 Respondent characteristics

# Limitations

The cross-sectional design limits causal interpretation.

# References

Smith, J. (2020). Staff retention in hospitals. Journal of Health Research, 2(1), 1–10.
